A private place for household teamwork.

TidyTroupe is designed around minimal profile information and local household records.

01

Use a nickname

Child profiles should not require real names, birth dates, email addresses or photographs.

02

Optional means optional

Microphone use and notifications should be opt-in. Speech processing depends on the installed service; no offline recognition guarantee is made.
